name: nikolai-jarvis
description: Asistente de IA tipo JARVIS con control por gestos de la mano, voz y muchos idiomas

scripts.check: node --check server.js && for f in public/js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.build:three: esbuild scripts/three-entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* three.js r170 · MIT License · https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js */" --outfile=public/vendor/three.mjs
